platforms.name: Hacker News
platforms.how: Show HN：标题+仓库链接，正文放第一条评论。周二~四 美西早 8-10 点最佳
platforms.title: Show HN: OpenCodex – a 4.7MB portable multi-terminal workbench for Claude Code
platforms.text:
I kept wanting one thing: open a project folder, split the view into several terminals, and run multiple Claude Code / Codex CLIs side by side — without a heavyweight Electron app eating 200MB.

So I built OpenCodex. It's folder-based: pick a folder, the main area IS a real terminal, split it left/right or top/bottom, run as many AI CLIs as you want. Closing a pane kills the whole child process tree (no orphan node processes). Splitting only repositions panes, so a running claude session never gets killed.

It's ~4.7MB (Tauri 2 + React, reuses the system WebView — no bundled Chromium). Bring-your-own-model: ships no API keys, talks to no server of its own. Point it at any OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoint (DeepSeek, Zhipu, ollama, Anthropic official, whatever).

Repo: https://github.com/dongsheng123132/opencodex
MIT. Feedback very welcome — early Demo, I use it daily.

Also open-sourced its document layer as Redline (Apache-2.0): a host-agnostic annotation layer for AI agents — open any of 11 formats (PDF/Word/Excel/PSD/3D/DXF/…) with no native app, mark it up, and the agent reads the markup to edit the real source file. https://github.com/dongsheng123132/redline
platforms.tips: HN 与 Reddit 别同一天发；前几小时守评论区决定能否上榜。

platforms.name: Reddit · r/ClaudeAI
platforms.title: I made a 4.7MB open-source workbench to run multiple Claude Code sessions in split terminals (per folder)
platforms.text:
The official desktop apps and most terminal managers are heavy (Electron, ~200MB) and built around human workflows. I wanted something AI-first and lightweight: open a folder, split into several terminals, run multiple Claude Code / Codex CLIs in parallel.

OpenCodex does exactly that in ~4.7MB (Tauri, reuses the system WebView):
- main area is a real terminal; split left/right or top/bottom
- splitting repositions panes — running sessions are never killed
- closing a pane kills the whole child process tree (no orphans)
- drag a file/image into the terminal → its path is typed in
- bring-your-own-model: no bundled keys, no server; any OAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoint
- layout remembered across restarts, adjustable font, WebGL rendering

MIT, early Demo, I use it daily. Repo: https://github.com/dongsheng123132/opencodex
Would love feedback on what to add next.

Also open-sourced its document layer as Redline (Apache-2.0): a host-agnostic annotation layer for AI agents — open any of 11 formats (PDF/Word/Excel/PSD/3D/DXF/…) with no native app, mark it up, and the agent reads the markup to edit the real source file. https://github.com/dongsheng123132/redline
platforms.tips: 先看置顶规则；r/ClaudeAI 最对口。

platforms.name: V2EX · 分享创造
platforms.title: 做了个 4.7MB 的绿色工具 OpenCodex：一个文件夹开多个终端，分屏跑 Claude Code
platforms.text:
一直想要这么个东西：打开一个项目文件夹，把界面分屏成几个终端，同时跑多个 Claude Code / Codex，互不打扰。但现成的桌面工具大多是 Electron，动辄 200MB，而且是面向"人"的操作逻辑，不是面向 AI 多终端协同的。

于是做了 OpenCodex，只有 ~4.7MB（Tauri，复用系统 WebView，不打包浏览器内核）：
- 以文件夹为基础，主区直接是终端，左右/上下随手分屏
- 分屏只是挪位置，正在跑的 claude 终端永远不会被杀
- 关终端连子进程树一起清，不留孤儿 node 进程
- 拖文件/图片/文件夹进终端 → 真实路径自动填进命令行
- 自带模型：不内置任何 Key、不连任何服务器，填你自己的端点（DeepSeek / 智谱 / Kimi / ollama / Anthropic 官方都行）
- 布局关 App 重开自动恢复、字号可调、WebGL 渲染高频刷新顺滑

开源 MIT，目前是 Demo 版，我自己天天在用。仓库：https://github.com/dongsheng123132/opencodex
欢迎提 issue 说说还想要啥功能。

顺手把它的文档标注层也开源了 —— Redline（Apache-2.0）：面向 AI agent 的通用文档标注层，不装 Office/CAD/PS 就能打开 11 种格式，人圈选画箭头写批注，AI 据此去改源文件，Redline 自己从不写回源文件。https://github.com/dongsheng123132/redline
platforms.tips: ⭐ 程序员聚集最对口；标题别标题党。

platforms.name: 微信朋友圈
platforms.how: 手机端发（网页无提交页），配图
platforms.text:
开源了个小东西 OpenCodex 🦞：4.7MB 绿色版，一个文件夹开多个终端分屏跑 Claude Code，自带模型无服务器。受够了 200MB 的 Electron 重型工具，就想要个轻的。MIT 开源 👉 https://github.com/dongsheng123132/opencodex

顺手把它的文档标注层也开源了 —— Redline（Apache-2.0）：面向 AI agent 的通用文档标注层，不装 Office/CAD/PS 就能打开 11 种格式，人圈选画箭头写批注，AI 据此去改源文件，Redline 自己从不写回源文件。https://github.com/dongsheng123132/redline
platforms.tips: 朋友圈只能手机发；文案+主图先在这拷好。
